symptom: A loop written by `create microflow` got its box Size from its body's ABSOLUTE canvas coordinates, so moving the loop 600px right grew the box by exactly 600 (body at 600,300 -> 710;380; at 1200,300 -> 1310;380, the issue's own numbers), and the centred box swallowed its neighbours. MPR008/MPR011 then blamed the neighbourhood.
cause: Three coordinate spaces met in one loop body. @position is a canvas coordinate everywhere in the language, but a loop's ObjectCollection stores children relative to the loop's top-left frame; addStatement filed the authored value raw, fitContainerSize measured those canvas values, and Studio Pro drew the child at canvas offset inside the frame. The box then grew with where the loop sat.
file: mdl/executor/cmd_microflows_builder_graph.go (addStatement records the consumed canvas @position per built object; save/restore across nested dispatches so an IF's branches do not wipe the split's), mdl/executor/cmd_microflows_builder_control.go (fitContainerSizeWithAuthored bounds the box around the loop's own anchor; finalize translates authored children and re-derives mergeSideFor tail sides), mdl/executor/layout.go, cmd_microflows_show_helpers.go (describe adds the frame back on @position/@merge inside loop bodies via ExecContext.describeFrameOrigin), cmd_flow_modify.go (storedLocator.within translates; pinBody; storedLoopStatement composes origins), flow_splice_loop_body.go
fix: Canvas in, frame stored: authored children and @merge-positioned merges are recorded per ID and translated into the frame at the container's finalize; describe adds the frame back on emission so describe->exec stays byte-identical for both Studio Pro and mxcli-authored flows; the splice locator, pinBody and storedLoopStatement translate the other way; enum-split tail sides are re-derived at finalize when the creation-time comparison mixed spaces.
insight: A stored-space change radiates to every consumer of the convention: builder, describer, splice locator, pin sets, storedLoopStatement, and flow siding that reads objectPosition mid-build. Fix it as one contract (canvas in the language, frame in storage, translate at the boundary in both directions) rather than patching consumers one by one. Geometry comparisons during the build (mergeSideFor via objectPosition) must run on final positions - derive sides at finalize, not creation, or the side depends on which space each operand was in at creation time. mxcli-authored loop children stored canvas-raw before, so old scripts' stored geometry CHANGES on re-exec (and that is the fix: the sticky wrong box from the issue heals on rebuild).
test: mdl/executor/issue1935_loop_box_test.go (box independent of loop position for loop and while; child stored relative to frame; auto-placed and @size contracts kept)
